decisions.reason: As an adjacent product for sewer and utility customers that uses the firm's existing fabrication skills, it is still an inexpensive option to keep while market demand remains uncertain.

Public waste bins are relatively distant from the firm's core offer and customer relationships, so with several other new options in the portfolio management is more likely to reallocate attention and capacity away from this line.

Ground sleeves for posts fit the firm's metalworking capabilities and can likely be carried at low cost, so the firm has reason to keep this broader line on the market until its value becomes clearer.

Cast iron ground sleeves are close to the new sleeves line and established fabrication business, and despite some overlap the uncertainty is still high enough that keeping the variant remains worthwhile.
Steel ground sleeves are strongly aligned with the firm's existing materials expertise and likely cheap to continue offering, so the option value of waiting exceeds the near-term carrying cost.
